claim.claim-text: 2. A method according to claim 1, wherein the method further comprises: overwrite existing location data, originating from the aerosol provision device, that is already stored in the memory with the location data.
3. A method according to any preceding claim, wherein the remote wireless device comprises a mobile communications device.
4. A method according to any preceding claim, wherein the remote wireless device comprises at least one of a mobile phone; a smartphone, or a tablet device.
5. A method according to claim 1, wherein the location is in the form of GPS coordinates.
6. A method according to any preceding claim, wherein the location is in the form of a map grid reference.

7. A method according to any preceding claim, wherein the data from the aerosol provision device further comprises information for identifying the aerosol provision device, and the method further comprises the remote wireless device, after receiving the data from the aerosol provision device: searching for data in the memory of the remote wireless device which contains the information for identifying the aerosol provision device.
8. A method according to claim 7, wherein the information comprises a product type; batch number; serial number; and/or UUID, of the aerosol provision device.
